title: Holo Lifesteal Plugin
description: Simple Lifesteal Plugin that allows players to steal other players hearts by killing them.
body:
Supported Versions: 1.18.2

### Required
EssentialsX

### Features
Life steal, Upon killing a player you gain a heart and they loose a heart
Eliminations, when a player reaches 0 hearts they are eliminated
Staff can modify a player's hearts, eliminate and revive players.

### Commands
/health set {playername} {amount of hearts}
Description: Withdraw/Give hearts!
Permission: hololifesteal.health
